{{Quote|Sledgehammer, please.|Thaymes Fodrick to a bartender.|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Sledgehammer''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink served at [[Jokko Haning's Emporium]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Thaymes Fodrick]] visited the bar and ordered a sledgehammer from the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] while speaking with [[Myri Antilles]], who was also working undercover as part of a separate Wraith Squadron unit.<ref name="MK" />
